name: Arrow
author: OpenPen
description: Straight-line tool with arrowheads. Solid, open, or hollow heads; optional double-ended. Hold Shift to snap to 45°.
changelog: Options panel in the control bar: click the caret next to the Arrow button to set line width, head style, line style and double-headed.
New line styles: solid, dashed and dotted; the arrowhead always stays solid.
New shortcut Ctrl+Alt+A (Cmd+Option+A on macOS) switches to the Arrow tool; it can be rebound in Settings.
